description: Mada hii inafundisha maana na matumizi ya methali, misemo na nahau, tofauti zake, maana fiche, jinsi ya kuzitumia katika sentensi, pamoja na dhima zake katika jamii.

options.text: Ni usemi mfupi wa kimapokeo wenye busara na mafunzo kwa jamii
Ni hadithi ndefu ya mashujaa wa kale
Ni orodha ya maneno mageni yasiyo na maana

mcq.explanation: A proverb (methali) is a short traditional saying carrying wisdom and a lesson for society.

options.text: Ni fungu la maneno lenye maana tofauti na maana ya kawaida ya maneno yenyewe
Ni jina la mtu maarufu katika jamii
Ni sentensi ndefu yenye majina mengi

mcq.explanation: An idiom (nahau) is a group of words whose meaning differs from the literal meaning of the individual words.

mcq.questionText: Methali 'Haba na haba hujaza kibaba' inafundisha jambo gani?
mcq.explanation: This proverb teaches that gathering small amounts gradually leads to a large amount; persistence and saving little by little brings abundance.
The idiom 'kula njama' means to plot or conspire secretly, not to eat anything.

mcq.questionText: Tofauti kuu kati ya methali na nahau ni ipi?

options.text: Methali ni sentensi kamili yenye mafunzo, nahau ni fungu la maneno lisilokamilika peke yake
Methali huandikwa tu, nahau husemwa tu
Methali ni mpya, nahau ni za kale

mcq.explanation: A proverb is a complete sentence conveying a lesson, while an idiom is a phrase that does not stand alone as a complete thought.

mcq.questionText: Methali 'Asiyesikia la mkuu huvunjika guu' inatoa onyo gani?

options.text: Mtu asiyekubali ushauri wa wakubwa hupatwa na madhara

mcq.explanation: This proverb warns that whoever refuses to heed advice from elders or experienced people suffers harm.

mcq.questionText: Neno lipi katika sentensi 'Juma alipiga moyo konde akaingia darasani kujibu maswali' ni nahau?
mcq.explanation: 'Piga moyo konde' is an idiom meaning to take courage or become brave, used here to show Juma steeled himself.

options.text: Misemo mara nyingi hukosa mafunzo mazito na huwa myepesi kuliko methali
Misemo ni mirefu zaidi kuliko methali
Misemo huandikwa kwa lugha za kigeni pekee

mcq.explanation: Sayings (misemo) are short expressions that often lack the deep moral lesson found in proverbs and tend to be lighter.

mcq.questionText: Methali 'Mtaka cha mvunguni sharti ainame' ina maana gani fiche?

options.text: Anayetaka kufanikiwa lazima ajitahidi na avumilie tabu
Ni lazima kufagia chini ya kitanda kila siku
Watu wafupi pekee wanaweza kufanya kazi
Mvunguni ni mahali pa kuhifadhi chakula

mcq.explanation: Figuratively, whoever wants something valuable (under the bed) must bend down, meaning success requires effort and enduring hardship.
The idiom 'kunja jamvi' means to wind up or bring an activity to an end.

mcq.questionText: Dhima moja kuu ya methali katika jamii ni ipi?

options.text: Kuelimisha, kuonya na kuhifadhi maadili ya jamii

mcq.explanation: One key role of proverbs is to educate, warn and preserve the moral values of society.

mcq.questionText: Methali 'Penye nia pana njia' inahimiza nini?

options.text: Mtu mwenye azimio thabiti hupata njia ya kufanikisha lengo lake
Watu wenye nia mbaya pekee hupata njia

mcq.explanation: This proverb encourages determination: where there is a will (nia) there is a way to achieve one's goal.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Baada ya kifo cha baba yao, watoto walibaki yatima', nahau 'kubaki yatima' inaonyesha nini?

options.text: Hii si nahau bali ni maelezo ya kawaida

mcq.explanation: Here 'kubaki yatima' is used in its literal sense (the children became orphans), so it functions as ordinary description rather than a figurative idiom.

mcq.questionText: Methali 'Pole pole ndiyo mwendo' inafundisha nini?

options.text: Kufanya jambo kwa utaratibu na subira huleta mafanikio
Mwendo wa haraka ni bora zaidi

mcq.explanation: This proverb teaches that doing things steadily and patiently brings success; haste is not always best.

mcq.questionText: Nahau hupatikana zaidi katika kipengele kipi cha lugha?

options.text: Katika matumizi ya kawaida ya mazungumzo na maandishi ya kifasihi

mcq.explanation: Idioms appear widely in everyday conversation and literary writing, enriching the expressiveness of the language.

fib.questionText: Usemi mfupi wa kimapokeo wenye busara na mafunzo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A methali (proverb) is a short traditional saying carrying wisdom and lessons.

fib.questionText: Fungu la maneno lenye maana fiche tofauti na maana ya kawaida huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A nahau (idiom) carries a hidden meaning different from the literal words.

fib.questionText: Methali 'Haraka haraka _____ baraka' inaonya dhidi ya pupa.
fib.explanation: The proverb 'Haraka haraka haina baraka' warns that hastiness has no blessing.
The proverb 'Mvumilivu hula mbivu' means the patient one eats the ripe fruit, encouraging patience.

fib.questionText: Maana iliyojificha ndani ya methali au nahau huitwa maana _____.
fib.explanation: Maana fiche is the hidden or figurative meaning behind a proverb or idiom.

fib.questionText: Nahau '_____ moyo konde' ina maana ya kujipa ujasiri.
fib.explanation: The idiom 'piga moyo konde' means to take courage or brace oneself.

fib.questionText: Methali 'Akili ni _____, kila mtu ana yake' inaonyesha tofauti za fikra za watu.
fib.explanation: The proverb 'Akili ni nywele, kila mtu ana yake' means wisdom is like hair, everyone has their own, showing people think differently.

fib.questionText: Kamilisha methali hii: 'Mgaagaa na upwa hali _____.'
fib.explanation: Methali kamili ni 'Mgaagaa na upwa hali wali', inayohusu bidii na kuendelea kujitahidi katika kutafuta riziki.

fib.questionText: Usemi mwepesi usio na mafunzo mazito kama methali huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A msemo (saying) is a light expression that lacks the deep lesson of a proverb.

fib.questionText: Methali 'Umoja ni nguvu, utengano ni _____' inahimiza ushirikiano.
fib.explanation: The proverb 'Umoja ni nguvu, utengano ni udhaifu' means unity is strength and division is weakness.

tf.questionText: Methali ni sentensi kamili yenye mafunzo kwa jamii.
tf.explanation: True. A proverb is a complete sentence that conveys a lesson to society.

tf.questionText: Nahau hutafsiriwa kwa kuangalia maana ya kawaida ya kila neno.
tf.explanation: False. Idioms have figurative meanings that differ from the literal meaning of the individual words.

tf.questionText: Methali na nahau ni sehemu ya fasihi simulizi ya jadi ya jamii.
tf.explanation: True. Proverbs and idioms are part of the traditional oral literature of the community.

tf.questionText: Nahau 'kula njama' ina maana ya kula chakula cha jioni.
tf.explanation: False. 'Kula njama' means to plot or conspire secretly, not to eat food.

tf.questionText: Methali 'Haba na haba hujaza kibaba' inahimiza kukusanya kidogokidogo.
tf.explanation: True. The proverb teaches that small amounts accumulated gradually fill a measure.

tf.questionText: Misemo na methali ni vitu vile vile vyenye sifa zote sawa.
tf.explanation: False. Sayings (misemo) are usually lighter and often lack the deep moral lesson that proverbs carry.

tf.questionText: Dhima mojawapo ya methali ni kuelimisha na kuonya jamii.
tf.explanation: True. Proverbs serve to educate, warn and preserve societal values.

tf.questionText: Nahau zinaweza kutumika kuipamba lugha katika mazungumzo na maandishi.
tf.explanation: True. Idioms beautify and enrich language in both speech and writing.

tf.questionText: Methali 'Asiyesikia la mkuu huvunjika guu' inahimiza kupuuza ushauri wa wazee.
tf.explanation: False. The proverb warns that ignoring elders' advice brings harm, so it encourages listening, not ignoring.

tf.questionText: Maana fiche ni maana halisi ya neno moja moja katika nahau.
tf.explanation: False. Maana fiche (figurative meaning) is the hidden meaning, not the literal meaning of individual words.

hoq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Mwalimu alituambia kuwa mwizi alikamatwa baada ya kuiba, kwani mtaka cha mvunguni sharti ainame', methali iliyotumika inafaa kufundisha jambo gani kuhusu juhudi?

options.text: Anayetaka kufaidi jambo lazima ajitahidi na avumilie tabu zinazoambatana nalo
Wizi ni njia bora ya kupata mali

hoq.explanation: The proverb 'mtaka cha mvunguni sharti ainame' teaches that achieving a goal requires effort and enduring hardship; the sentence misapplies it to theft, but the proverb's lesson is about legitimate striving.

hoq.questionText: Mwanafunzi anataka kueleza kuwa kikundi cha wanafunzi kilipanga kwa siri kususia mtihani. Ni nahau ipi inayofaa zaidi kutumika?
hoq.explanation: 'Kula njama' means to plot or conspire secretly, which precisely fits secretly planning to boycott the exam; the other idioms have different meanings.

hoq.questionText: Ni kauli ipi inayoeleza kwa usahihi tofauti ya kimsingi kati ya methali, msemo na nahau?

options.text: Methali ni sentensi kamili yenye mafunzo, msemo ni usemi mwepesi, na nahau ni fungu la maneno lenye maana fiche
Zote tatu ni sentensi kamili zenye mafunzo sawa
Methali na nahau ni mpya, ila msemo ni wa kale
Nahau pekee ndizo zenye maana ya kawaida ya maneno

hoq.explanation: A proverb is a complete sentence with a lesson, a saying is a lighter expression, and an idiom is a phrase carrying a figurative meaning; this captures the core distinctions.
